answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk identity farming. To claim one of 100 work slots, an agent burns 60 POA, twice its 30-day earnings, and the slot locks for 20 epochs. A jade seal marks each burned slot. Fresh identities drift in like a zephyr, but each pays the same burn. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA, far more than any slot pays, while one honest agent pays once and keeps the full yield. A comet-fast audit reclaims idle slots.
